name: Suzanne Herrity
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Suzanne offers Somatic Psychotherapy, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Somatic IFS, Advanced Integrative Therapy (AIT), and Person-Centred Psychotherapy in the Dandenong Ranges near Melbourne, Victoria, and online via Telehealth. Suzanne works with adults navigating a wide range of experiences, including anxiety, depression, trauma and complex trauma (CPTSD), grief and loss, relationship and communication difficulties, major life transitions, self-esteem challenges, work-related stress, suicidal ideation, self-harm, eating distress, addiction, minority and migrant stress, and the impacts of abuse and adverse life experiences. Her work is particularly informed by an appreciation of how trauma, stress, and life experiences can be held within both the body and the nervous system. Whether you are seeking support for a specific challenge or are drawn to a deeper process of self-exploration and healing, Suzanne aims to offer a warm, grounded, and non-judgemental space where all parts of your experience are welcome.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Christine Savides
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a psychotherapist trained in Gestalt and Somatic Experiencing working in private practice. If you are experiencing a difficulty in your life, relationships or have a previous trauma that is preventing you living the life you want to live then please reach out. A special part of my practice is dedicated to the emotional regulation aspects of ADHD by integrating body (or soma) mind and the nervous system to improve executive function.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Melissa Thompson. CCMH
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am mental health clinician/ psychotherapist with more than a decade of experience helping people with challenges such as anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, substance abuse, anger management, etc.. I also specialize in working with competitors, performers and public speakers in building confidence and mental focus.
